title: Create: Under Pressure
description: Adds a physics simulated, fluid transport capable hose, as well as a fluid-based linear actuator using Sable and Create Simulated.
body:
Create: Under Pressure
=======

An addon to the addon Create: Simulated, Under Pressure adds...well, linear actuator cylinders (for now), using SubLevels to improve upon the idea of Create's Mechanical Pistons. Due to this, there's also added Hoses so you can seamlessly integrate your Create fluid networks to a SubLevel!
 
## What does this mod add?
### Linear Actuator
While an item at first, right-click two points to assemble a fresh Cylinder between them! The newly formed Cylinder can then be built on as a normal Sable SubLevel for any type of controls you want! The Cylinder respects the weight of whatever load it's
pushing, so if you want to push REALLY heavy things, you might want to increase fluid pressure, get a more viscous fluid...or get more cylinders!

### Rubber Hose
An item that allows you to extend a physics-simulated, rope-like hose between two points! Also interacts with Create's
`Hose Pulley`, giving it a new functionality as a hose winch!

### Pressure Gauge
Reads fluid pressure passing through. Largely aesthetic (for now).

## Getting Started
For now, just go into Creative and get yourself a Linear Actuator item, and a Rubber Hose.

## Requirements
- Sable 2.0.3
- Create Aeronautics 1.3.0

---
## ⚠ DISCLAIMER ⚠
This mod is still in its **VERY** early stages and therefore **UNSTABLE**. As a one-man show for most of the mod's development, not to mention a complete beginner at modding in general, as I gain more experience I will be making breaking changes to the mod every major version, so I **CANNOT** recommend you use this in Survival Mode or any important builds quite *yet*. I'm making this mod primarily for fun, so if I take forever to fix something, it is what it is.
